intro: Where the data came from, what was done to it, under what authority, and how the labels were produced (bio-prov v0.2). Markers follow the obligations for a {tier} dataset, the access tier this dataset already has. Fill what you can; the check below names what is still missing.

requirement.P3: Upstream dataset this one was derived from
requirement.H2: Date of the collection or derivation activity
requirement.H6b: Annotation activity: guideline used and annotator roles
requirement.A1: Annotation write-back as a derived entity

issue.invalid: {label} is present but incomplete or malformed

preflight.failed: Could not check provenance. Try again.
preflight.completeBody: Every required and recommended item is present.
preflight.requiredMissing: {count, plural, one {# required item} other {# required items}} missing
preflight.recommendedMissing: {count, plural, one {# recommended item} other {# recommended items}} missing
preflight.missingBody: Each block below names what it needs. You can still continue; the platform reports the same items when you publish.

origin.title: Where did the data come from?
origin.orgNameHint: The institution the data is attributed to.
origin.orgIdHint: Recommended: a ROR (Research Organization Registry) IRI or the institution’s URL.
origin.sitesIntro: One row per site that contributed records, with its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (CH, KE, IN…). Subgroup reporting by site keys on this; it cannot be recovered later.
origin.derivedHint: Only for a slice, downsample or re-annotation of an existing dataset. A DOI IRI is preferred (https://doi.org/…). Leave blank for a primary collection.

processing.title: What was done to it?
processing.activityHint: One sentence, e.g. “Prospective collection of fundus photographs at two sites”.
processing.runByHintRequired: Required: the organisation, person or software that ran the activity. Blank means the source organisation.
processing.runByHint: The organisation, person or software that ran the activity. Blank means the source organisation.
processing.isSoftware: This is software (a pipeline or export tool) acting on behalf of the source organisation
processing.timeframeHint: The human account, e.g. “March 2019 to November 2021”. The activity dates above are the machine-readable form.
processing.deviceClassHintRequired: A DICOM modality code or GMDN (Global Medical Device Nomenclature) term, e.g. “OP (ophthalmic photography)”. Required: this or a manufacturer below.
processing.deviceClassHint: A DICOM modality code or GMDN (Global Medical Device Nomenclature) term, e.g. “OP (ophthalmic photography)”. This or a manufacturer below.
processing.noSerial: Never enter a device serial number; the validator rejects it.
processing.methodHint: The pass that produced the anonymisation level.
processing.resultingLevelHint: Read-only: the anonymisation level chosen on the Biomedical context step. The two must agree.
processing.resultingLevelPlaceholder: not declared on the Biomedical step
processing.toolHint: tool@version, when software ran the pass.

authority.title: Under what authority?
authority.approvingBodyHint: The ethics committee or institutional review board.
authority.scopeHint: Does the approval cover evaluation of third-party AI models on this data? That is the first question every data host is asked; say so here.

labels.title: How was the ground truth produced?
labels.intro: Version, scale and graders per item are the minimum. A single-grader reference is fine and is stated as 1; undocumented provenance is what fails.
labels.adjudicationHint: How disagreements were settled, e.g. “third grader adjudicates disagreements”.
labels.retainedHint: Whether each grader’s labels are kept alongside the consensus.
